The '''Skirmish on Prine''' took place several months after the creation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[Dass Jennir]] journeyed through the desert of [[Prine]] in order to rescue [[Ember Chankeli]] who was captured by a [[Unidentified caravan|enslaver caravan]].
